t: You're looking at the site of Livingstone College, a former medical college in Leyton, founded in 1893 for Christian missionaries. It taught them the elements of medicine before they went out to tropical countries, over a nine-month programme. It takes its name from David Livingstone, the Scottish doctor, missionary and explorer in Africa. He became one of the most popular British heroes of the late Victorian age, so the name fits a college that paired faith with medical training.
